instructions:
For each item, compare english with translation. back_translation is an independent machine translation of the translation back to English (made without seeing the English); use it as a hint only.
Set reviewer_verdict to "ok" when the translation is right, or "corrected" when you fixed it (then put the full replacement text in reviewer_correction). Leave both null if you skip the item. reviewer_note is free text for anything you want us to know.
Keep {{placeholders}} exactly as they are in reviewer_correction. Keep SafeRoute, Screen shield and Message Guard in English.
Do safety items first (priority "safety": verdict labels, red flags, report actions, hotlines and Get help, Learn scam guide, Message Guard, privacy and consent, error messages that say what to do). The app must say "looks risky" or "shows warning signs", never "is a scam".
machine_flag is a Gemini pre-screen plus automatic checks: ok, check or likely_wrong. A flag of ok does not mean the string is correct. machine_severity (0-10) ranks how bad the model thinks the problem is. auto_checks lists the deterministic checks that fired (length, latin, identical, placeholder, glossary, empty, zawgyi, mmorder).
Merge answers back with: node scripts/i18n-apply-review.mjs docs/i18n-review/languages-to-check.json (dry run) and add --write to apply. A namespace file is marked reviewed only when every key in it has an answer.

items.translation: SafeRoute သည် အက်ပ်၊ အစီရင်ခံစာများနှင့် အသံသတိပေးချက်များကို ဤဘာသာစကားဖြင့် ပြသပေးပါမည်။ နောက်ပိုင်းတွင်လည်း ပြန်ပြောင်းနိုင်ပါသည်။
items.back_translation: SafeRoute will display the app, reports, and voice warnings in this language. It can also be changed back later.

items.english: Everything works without an account. Your checks stay on this device.
items.translation: အကောင့်မရှိဘဲလည်း အားလုံးကို အသုံးပြုနိုင်ပါသည်။ သင်စစ်ဆေးထားမှုများသည် ဤဖုန်းထဲတွင်သာ ရှိနေပါမည်။
items.back_translation: You can use everything even without an account. Your checks will only remain in this phone.
items.context: Screen: First-run onboarding. Element: sentence or paragraph.

items.english: An account is optional. It saves your history and trusted contacts so you can get them back on a new phone, and it raises your hourly check limit.
items.translation: အကောင့်ဖွင့်ရန် မဖြစ်မနေ မလိုပါ။ အကောင့်ဖွင့်ထားပါက စစ်ဆေးထားသည့် မှတ်တမ်းများနှင့် ယုံကြည်ရသူများ စာရင်းကို သိမ်းဆည်းပေးထားသဖြင့် ဖုန်းအသစ်တွင် ပြန်လည်ရယူနိုင်ပြီး တစ်နာရီအတွင်း စစ်ဆေးနိုင်သည့် အကြိမ်အရေအတွက်ကိုလည်း ပိုမိုရရှိစေပါသည်။
items.back_translation: Opening an account is not mandatory. If an account is opened, checked records and trusted persons list are saved, so you can retrieve them on a new phone, and it also gives you more number of times you can check within an hour.

items.english: Help others: share anonymous scam patterns
items.translation: အခြားသူများကို ကူညီပါ- အန္တရာယ်ရှိနိုင်သော ပုံစံများကို အမည်မဖော်ဘဲ မျှဝေပါ
items.back_translation: Help others: Share potentially dangerous patterns anonymously
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: button or link label. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: No screenshots and no raw text are shared. Personal details are removed first, and phone numbers, accounts and links are stored only as one-way hashes. Patterns appear on the Scam radar once several people report them.
items.translation: စခရင်ရှော့များနှင့် မူရင်းစာများကို မျှဝေမည် မဟုတ်ပါ။ ကိုယ်ရေးအချက်အလက်များကို အရင်ဖယ်ရှားပြီး ဖုန်းနံပါတ်၊ အကောင့်နှင့် လင့်ခ်များကို ကုဒ်ပြောင်း၍သာ သိမ်းဆည်းပါသည်။ လူအများ တိုင်ကြားလာသည့်အခါမှသာ ထိုပုံစံများသည် လိမ်လည်မှု ရေဒါ တွင် ပေါ်လာပါမည်။
items.back_translation: Screenshots and original texts will not be shared. Personal information will be removed first, and phone numbers, accounts, and links are saved only by encoding. Only when many people report will those patterns appear on Scam Radar.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: sentence or paragraph. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: Your checks are saved on this device. Signed-in accounts also sync the report text, trusted contacts and settings. Screenshots are never saved or synced.
items.translation: စစ်ဆေးထားမှုများကို ဤဖုန်းတွင် သိမ်းဆည်းထားပါသည်။ အကောင့်ဝင်ထားပါက အစီရင်ခံစာစာသား၊ ယုံကြည်ရသူများ နှင့် ဆက်တင်များကိုလည်း အကောင့်တွင် သိမ်းပေးပါသည်။ စခရင်ရှော့များကို မည်သည့်အခါမျှ မသိမ်းဆည်းသလို အကောင့်သို့လည်း မပို့ပါ။
items.back_translation: Checks are saved on this phone. If logged in, report text, trusted people, and settings are also saved in the account. Screenshots are never saved, nor are they sent to the account.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: label or short text. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: To check something, SafeRoute sends the text, link or screenshot to our check service, which uses Google AI models and Google Safe Browsing to assess it. We do not log the content.
items.translation: စစ်ဆေးရန်အတွက် SafeRoute သည် စာသား၊ လင့်ခ် သို့မဟုတ် စခရင်ရှော့ကို စစ်ဆေးရေးစနစ်သို့ ပို့ပေးပြီး Google AI မော်ဒယ်များနှင့် Google Safe Browsing တို့ဖြင့် စစ်ဆေးပေးပါသည်။ ထိုအကြောင်းအရာများကို ကျွန်ုပ်တို့ မှတ်တမ်းတင် မသိမ်းဆည်းပါ။
items.back_translation: For checking, SafeRoute sends text, link or screenshot to the checking system and checks with Google AI models and Google Safe Browsing. We do not record and save those contents.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: label or short text. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: Each install gets an anonymous ID. We use it only to limit how many checks one person can run per hour.
items.translation: အက်ပ်ထည့်သွင်းမှုတစ်ခုစီအတွက် အမည်မဖော်သော ကုဒ်တစ်ခု ရရှိပါသည်။ ၎င်းကို လူတစ်ဦး တစ်နာရီလျှင် အကြိမ်မည်မျှ စစ်ဆေးနိုင်သည်ကို ကန့်သတ်ရန်သာ အသုံးပြုပါသည်။
items.back_translation: An anonymous code is obtained for each app installation. It is only used to limit how many times a person can check per hour.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: label or short text. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: No screenshots and no raw text are shared. Personal details are removed first, and phone numbers, accounts and links are stored only as one-way hashes. Patterns appear on the Scam radar once several people report them.
items.translation: Tangkapan layar dan teks asli tidak dibagikan. Data pribadi dihapus lebih dulu, lalu nomor HP, akun, dan tautan hanya disimpan dalam bentuk kode acak. Pola akan muncul di Radar penipuan setelah dilaporkan oleh beberapa orang.
items.back_translation: Screenshots and original text are not shared. Personal data is deleted first, then phone numbers, accounts, and links are only stored in the form of random codes. Patterns will appear in the Scam radar after being reported by several people.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: sentence or paragraph. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: Your checks are saved on this device. Signed-in accounts also sync the report text, trusted contacts and settings. Screenshots are never saved or synced.
items.translation: Hasil periksa Anda disimpan di perangkat ini. Akun yang masuk juga menyelaraskan teks laporan, kontak tepercaya, dan pengaturan. Tangkapan layar tidak pernah disimpan atau diselaraskan.
items.back_translation: Your check results are stored on this device. Logged-in accounts also sync report text, trusted contacts, and settings. Screenshots are never stored or synced.
items.machine_note: 'Akun yang masuk' is awkward phrasing for 'Signed-in accounts'; consider 'Jika masuk dengan akun...' alongside 'disinkronkan' instead of 'menyelaraskan'.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: label or short text. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: To check something, SafeRoute sends the text, link or screenshot to our check service, which uses Google AI models and Google Safe Browsing to assess it. We do not log the content.
items.translation: Untuk memeriksa sesuatu, SafeRoute mengirim teks, tautan, atau tangkapan layar ke layanan periksa kami, yang menggunakan model AI Google dan Google Safe Browsing untuk menilainya. Kami tidak mencatat isinya.
items.back_translation: To check something, SafeRoute sends text, links, or screenshots to our check service, which uses Google AI models and Google Safe Browsing to assess it. We do not record the contents.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: label or short text. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: Each install gets an anonymous ID. We use it only to limit how many checks one person can run per hour.
items.translation: Setiap pemasangan aplikasi mendapat ID anonim tanpa nama. Kami hanya memakainya untuk membatasi jumlah pemeriksaan per jam bagi setiap orang.
items.back_translation: Each app installation gets an anonymous ID without a name. We only use it to limit the number of checks per hour for each person.
items.machine_note: 'ID anonim tanpa nama' is redundant ('anonim' already means without a name); consider 'ID tanpa nama' for low literacy.

items.english: No screenshots and no raw text are shared. Personal details are removed first, and phone numbers, accounts and links are stored only as one-way hashes. Patterns appear on the Scam radar once several people report them.
items.translation: ไม่มีการแชร์ภาพหน้าจอหรือข้อความเดิม ข้อมูลส่วนตัวจะถูกลบออกก่อน ส่วนเบอร์โทร บัญชี และลิงก์จะถูกแปลงรหัสแบบทางเดียวเท่านั้น ข้อมูลรูปแบบจะแสดงในเรดาร์มิจฉาชีพเมื่อมีหลายคนแจ้งเข้ามา
items.back_translation: No sharing of screenshots or original messages. Personal data will be deleted first. As for phone numbers, accounts, and links, they will be one-way encoded only. Pattern data will display in the scammer radar when multiple people report in.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: sentence or paragraph. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: Your checks are saved on this device. Signed-in accounts also sync the report text, trusted contacts and settings. Screenshots are never saved or synced.

items.back_translation: Your check results will be saved on this device. If logged in, report messages, trusted contacts, and settings will also be synced. Screenshots will not be saved or synced at all.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: label or short text. Privacy and consent text..

items.english: To check something, SafeRoute sends the text, link or screenshot to our check service, which uses Google AI models and Google Safe Browsing to assess it. We do not log the content.

items.back_translation: In checking, SafeRoute will send messages, links, or screenshots to our inspection system, which uses Google AI models and Google Safe Browsing to assess risk. We do not record and store content.
items.context: Screen: Settings screen. Element: label or short text. Privacy and consent text..
